description: Resource usage against a limit, with a value and a visual state.

howToUse: Use it in plan and billing screens to show what was used of a limit: credits, storage, seats.
Pass `label`, `used`, `limit` and `unit`. Put the detail in `meta` ("8 analyses this month").
The color changes by itself at `warnAt` and `criticalAt`. Next to it, offer what to do when it is about to run out.
alternatives: A number with a trend, with no limit: Stat.

keyboard.action: The meter does not receive focus. Screen readers read the name, the value and the limit.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the measured resource. E.g. "Cycle credits".

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown after the numbers. E.g. "credits".

props.name: meta
props.description: Secondary line. E.g. "8 standard analyses · 0 syntheses".

props.name: warnAt
props.description: % from which the tone turns to warning (default 80).

props.name: criticalAt
props.description: % from which the tone turns critical (default 100).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
